# /coder — Coder (existing repo persona)

> Added 2026-11-10 as a pointer. **Not a new bot and not a box bot** (no `bot-` prefix on purpose). This persona is already defined in revvel-standards (`scripts/openrouter-personas.js`, `PERSONA_REGISTRY.coder`) and summoned by `/coder` in an issue/PR comment via `persona-comment-trigger.yml`. Non-bot commenters only.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Call name | `/coder` |
| Aliases | `/fixer`, `/patcher` |
| Role | Fixer — applies the fix in code (consumes Devin/Octopus prompts) |
| Routing profile | `repo_surgery` |

## Description (from the registry)

Applies code fixes from issues and review findings. Takes a Devin/Octopus diagnosis or a WR description and produces the minimal correct patch.
